# Cue 1.2.0 — App actions / App 動作
## English
App results now offer a small action menu while Return keeps opening the selected app.
[Download Cue 1.2.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.2.0/Cue-1.2.0-universal.dmg) · [Checksums](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.2.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
### Changes
- **Show in Finder:** select an app and press **Command+R** to reveal and select its bundle in Finder. Cue closes immediately; the app is not launched. No additional Accessibility permission is needed. - **App action menu:** the selected row’s **…** button and right-click menu contain **Open ↩**, **Show in Finder ⌘R**, and **Edit Search Alias… ⌘E**. Escape keeps the query and selection. **Command+K** still offers Google/GPT actions for the input text; **Command+Return** still searches Google. - **Correct history recall:** Finder actions are recorded separately from app launches and honor the history recording switch. Recall shows the original app and action; Return reveals it again. Editing or changing selection restores ordinary launching. A missing target never executes a different action, and revealing does not train app-launch ranking. - **Keep input fast:** menus are built only on request. Filesystem validation runs on a worker only after execution. Reopening Cue, editing input, dismissing it, or entering Settings cancels a pending Finder handoff. Stale menu items cannot act on a replacement row. No dependencies, network requests, polling or typing delays were added. English and Traditional Chinese are included.
### Install or upgrade
With Cue networking allowed, choose **Check for Updates…**, then **Install and Relaunch**. To install manually, quit Cue, open the DMG, replace your installed **Cue.app**, and reopen it. Settings and history are preserved; use a writable location rather than running from the DMG.
For an existing source clone, quit Cue, run `git pull --ff-only` and `./scripts/install-app.sh`, then reopen `~/Applications/Cue.app`. **Command Line Tools with Swift 6 or later** suffice; full Xcode is optional. Source builds default to Cue-owned networking and automatic checks **off**; official DMGs default to **on**. Saved choices take precedence. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.2.0/docs/installation.md) and [source guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.2.0/docs/building.md).
### Validation and limitations
Optimized tests and isolated native checks on **Apple silicon / macOS 27 / Xcode 27** cover app menus, shortcuts, IME composition, history recall, missing targets, cancellation, stale completions and existing features. Performance comparisons use synthetic data and offscreen native views; they do not measure physical input-to-display latency. Standalone **Command Line Tools / Swift 6.4** also build and validate the source bundle.
Finder’s actual foreground handoff and physical menu interaction were not desktop-tested in this round. Intel and other macOS versions, a full public Sparkle download/install/relaunch cycle, real Spotlight results, live GPT/currency requests, power actions and fresh permission flows were not re-tested. The Safari secure-input panel fix is retained from 1.1.2.
Cue remains **ad hoc signed without Apple Developer ID signing or notarization**. Follow the installation guide for macOS first-launch approval; window controls and selected-text conversion may need Accessibility permission granted again after an update.
## 正體中文
App 搜尋結果新增小型動作選單，Return 仍直接開啟選取的 App。
[下載 Cue 1.2.0](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.2.0/Cue-1.2.0-universal.dmg) · [校驗碼](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v1.2.0/SHA256SUMS.txt)
### 更新內容
- **在 Finder 中顯示：**選取 App 後按 **Command+R**，即可在 Finder 中顯示並選取其 App 套件。Cue 立即收起，不會啟動該 App，也不需額外的輔助使用權限。 - **App 動作選單：**選取列的 **…** 按鈕與右鍵選單提供**開啟 ↩**、**在 Finder 中顯示 ⌘R**、**編輯搜尋別名… ⌘E**。Escape 保留查詢與選取；**Command+K** 仍選擇針對輸入文字的 Google／GPT 動作，**Command+Return** 仍使用 Google 搜尋。 - **正確還原歷史動作：**Finder 動作與 App 啟動分開記錄，並遵守指令歷史的記錄開關。回看時顯示原 App 與動作，按 Return 再次於 Finder 顯示；修改文字或切換選取後恢復一般開啟。目標不存在時不改用其他動作，Finder 操作也不計入 App 啟動排序學習。 - **維持輸入流暢：**只有要求時才建立選單；執行後才在背景檢查檔案路徑。重新叫出 Cue、修改輸入、關閉或進入設定，都會取消尚未完成的 Finder 交接；過期選單不會操作替換到同一列的其他 App。沒有新增相依套件、網路請求、輪詢或打字等待，介面包含英文與正體中文。
### 安裝或升級
允許 Cue 自行連網後，選**檢查更新⋯**，再依提示**安裝並重新啟動**（**Install and Relaunch**）。手動安裝則先結束 Cue，開啟 DMG，取代已安裝的 **Cue.app** 後重新開啟。設定與歷史保留；請從可寫入位置執行，不要直接在 DMG 內更新。
已有原始碼 clone 的話，先結束 Cue，執行 `git pull --ff-only` 與 `./scripts/install-app.sh`，再重新開啟 `~/Applications/Cue.app`。只需 **Swift 6 以上的 Command Line Tools**，不必安裝完整 Xcode。自行建置版預設關閉 Cue 自行連網與自動檢查更新，正式 DMG 預設開啟；已有儲存的選擇優先沿用。詳見[安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.2.0/docs/installation.md)與[原始碼安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v1.2.0/docs/building.md)。
### 驗證範圍與限制
在 **Apple silicon／macOS 27／Xcode 27** 執行最佳化測試與隔離原生檢查，涵蓋 App 選單、快捷鍵、輸入法組字、歷史回看、遺失目標、取消、過期完成回呼及既有功能。效能比較使用合成資料與離屏原生視窗，不代表實體按鍵到畫面的延遲；也使用獨立 **Command Line Tools／Swift 6.4** 建置並驗證自行建置版套件。
本輪未操作桌面驗證 Finder 的實際前景切換與選單實體按鍵。Intel、其他 macOS 版本、完整公開 Sparkle 下載／安裝／重啟流程、真實 Spotlight 結果、GPT／匯率真實請求、電源動作及重新設定權限，也未重新驗證；保留 1.1.2 的 Safari 安全輸入焦點修正。
Cue 仍採用 **ad-hoc 簽章，沒有 Apple Developer ID 簽署與公證**。macOS 首次開啟請依安裝說明核准；更新後，視窗調整與選取文字轉換可能需要重新允許輔助使用權限。
